description: Intercom provides live chat, messaging, and customer engagement tools, enabling businesses to drive conversions, handle support, and personalize communication at scale

tools.name: Add subscription to a contact
tools.description: You can add a specific subscription to a contact. In Intercom, we have two different subscription types based on user consent - opt-out and opt-in: 1.Attaching a contact to an opt-out subscription type will opt that user out from receiving messages related to that subscription type. 2.Attaching a contact to an opt-in subscription type will opt that user in to receiving messages related to that subscription type. This will return a subscription type model for the subscription type that was added to the contact.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the subscription which is given by Intercom

inputs.name: contact_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the contact which is given by Intercom

inputs.name: consent_type
inputs.about: The consent_type of a subscription, opt_out or opt_in.

tools.name: Assign conversation
tools.description: Assigns a conversation to a specific admin or team in Intercom. Mutates live conversation state; confirm intent before bulk-assigning multiple conversations.

inputs.name: conversation_id
inputs.about: The ID of the conversation to assign

tools.description: Closes an Intercom conversation as an admin, optionally including a closing message. Closing requires a separate reopen action to reverse.

tools.name: Create contact
tools.description: Tool to create a new contact in Intercom workspace. Use when you need to add a user or lead to Intercom. At least one identifier (email, external_id, or role) must be provided.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Contact's full name

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: The contact's role designation (user/lead). At least one identifier (email, external_id, or role) must be provided.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: The contact's email address. At least one identifier (email, external_id, or role) must be provided.

inputs.name: phone
inputs.about: Contact phone number (E.164 format recommended, e.g., +353871234567)

inputs.name: avatar
inputs.about: Image URL for the contact's avatar

inputs.name: owner_id
inputs.about: Admin ID assigned as account owner

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.about: A unique identifier from your system. At least one identifier (email, external_id, or role) must be provided.

inputs.name: last_seen_at
inputs.about: Unix timestamp of last activity

inputs.name: signed_up_at
inputs.about: Unix timestamp of signup date

inputs.name: custom_attributes
inputs.about: Custom key-value data fields

inputs.name: unsubscribed_from_emails
inputs.about: Email subscription status

tools.name: Create content import source

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: The URL of the content import source. Must be a valid URL.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: The status of the content import source. Defaults to 'active'.

inputs.name: sync_behavior
inputs.about: Defines sync method.

tools.name: Create conversation
tools.description: Creates a new Intercom conversation from a user or contact. At least one user or contact ID is required; if both are supplied, the user ID takes precedence.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: The message content for the conversation

inputs.name: subject
inputs.about: Subject line for the conversation

inputs.name: from_user_id
inputs.about: ID of the user to create the conversation from. Either from_user_id or from_contact_id is required

inputs.name: message_type
inputs.about: Type of message: inapp, email, or facebook

inputs.name: from_admin_id
inputs.about: ID of the admin creating the conversation. If not provided, uses authenticated admin

inputs.name: from_contact_id
inputs.about: ID of the contact to create the conversation from. Either from_user_id or from_contact_id is required

tools.name: Create data attribute
tools.description: Tool to create a custom data attribute for contacts or companies. Use when you need to define a new attribute to track additional information beyond standard fields.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The identifier for the data attribute. This will be the key used to reference the attribute.

inputs.name: model
inputs.about: Specifies which object type this attribute applies to. Must be either 'contact' or 'company'.

inputs.name: options
inputs.about: Required when data_type is 'options'. Array of option objects, each containing a 'value' property.

inputs.name: data_type
inputs.about: The type of data stored. Valid values: 'string', 'integer', 'float', 'boolean', or 'date'.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: A readable description of the attribute shown in the UI. Helps users understand the purpose of the attribute.

inputs.name: messenger_writable
inputs.about: Whether the Messenger can update this attribute. Set to true to allow updates via Messenger.

tags: Data & Analytics (Events, Attributes, Exports, Jobs, Counts, Custom Objects)

tools.name: Create data event
tools.description: Tool to submit a data event to Intercom to track user activities. Use when you need to notify Intercom of user actions and changes. Events are detected as duplicates using workspace ID, contact identifier, event name, and timestamp.

inputs.name: id
inputs.about: Intercom's 24-character UUID identifier for a lead or user. The contact must already exist in Intercom; events cannot be created for non-existent contacts. At least one of user_id, id, or email is required.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: The user's email address. The contact with this email must already exist in Intercom; events cannot be created for non-existent contacts. Use only when email uniquely identifies users. At least one of user_id, id, or email is required.

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: Your application's unique identifier for the user. The contact must already exist in Intercom with this user_id; events cannot be created for non-existent contacts. At least one of user_id, id, or email is required.

inputs.name: metadata
inputs.about: Additional key-value pairs providing context about the event. Can include custom properties relevant to the event.

inputs.name: created_at
inputs.about: Unix timestamp indicating when the event occurred.

inputs.name: event_name
inputs.about: The name of the event in past tense verb-noun format (e.g., 'updated-plan', 'purchased-item'). Describes what action occurred.

tags: Data & Analytics (Events, Attributes, Exports, Jobs, Counts, Custom Objects)

tools.name: Create data export
tools.description: Tool to initiate an async data export job for message content. Use when you need to export messages created within a specific timeframe. Only one active job per workspace is allowed; exceeding this limit triggers a 429 error. Jobs expire two days after completion.

inputs.name: created_at_after
inputs.about: Start date for data export; must be formatted as a UNIX timestamp. Only messages created after this time will be included.

inputs.name: created_at_before

tools.name: Update content import source
tools.description: Tool to update an existing content import source in Fin Content Library. Use when you need to modify the URL, sync behavior, or status of an existing content import source.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: The URL of the content import source. Must be a valid URL.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: The operational state of the source. Allowed values: 'active', 'deactivated'. Defaults to 'active'.

inputs.name: source_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the content import source which is given by Intercom.

inputs.name: sync_behavior
inputs.about: Controls how the source is synchronized. Via API, the only allowed value is 'api'.

inputs.name: data_attribute_id

tools.name: Update external page
tools.description: Tool to update an existing external page in Fin Content Library. Use when you need to modify the content, metadata, or availability settings of an external page. Only pages created through the API can be updated.

inputs.name: url
inputs.about: The page URL; used by Fin to attribute answers to sources. Must be a valid URL. Required for updates.

inputs.name: html
inputs.about: The body content of the external page in HTML format. Required for updates.

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: The title of the external page. Required for updates.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.about: Language identifier code. Must be 'en'. Required for updates.

inputs.name: page_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier for the external page provided by Intercom

inputs.name: source_id
inputs.about: Identifier for the content import source. This links the page to a specific content import source in your workspace. Required for updates.

inputs.name: external_id
inputs.about: The identifier for the external page which was given by the source. Required for updates.

inputs.name: fin_availability
inputs.about: Whether the external page should be used to answer questions by Fin. Defaults to true if not provided.

tags: Content Management (Articles, Help Center, External Pages, News, Imports)
